cards.meaning: no matter what/how ... always — asserts a result holds regardless of the condition
cards.example: 不管市场情绪多悲观，只要基本面够硬，股价就能反弹。
cards.examplePinyin: bù guǎn shì chǎng qíng xù duō bēi guān, zhǐ yào jī běn miàn gòu yìng, gǔ jià jiù néng fǎn tán
cards.exampleMeaning: No matter how pessimistic market sentiment gets, as long as the fundamentals are strong enough, the stock can rebound.
cards.note: Near-synonym contrast with 无论……都……: 不管 is more colloquial, carrying a firm 'whatever happens, the result is the same' tone; 无论 is more formal/written, common in policy or news-analysis register. Using 不管 here emphasizes a judgment that isn't swayed by sentiment.
cards.tiesTo: Kospi's -5.8%/+6.1% two-day round trip on the SK Hynix buyback

cards.pinyin: biǎo miàn shàng ... shí jì shàng ...
cards.pronunciation: biao mian shang ... shi ji shang ...
cards.meaning: on the surface ... but in reality ... — a contrast pair distinguishing appearance from underlying fact
cards.example: 表面上沃尔玛的业绩超出预期，但实际上市场担心这份增长的含金量。
cards.examplePinyin: biǎo miàn shàng wò ěr mǎ de yè jì chāo chū yù qī, dàn shí jì shàng shì chǎng dān xīn zhè fèn zēng zhǎng de hán jīn liàng
cards.exampleMeaning: On the surface Walmart's results beat expectations, but in reality the market is worried about the quality of that growth.
cards.note: 书面语 (formal register), a standard finance-reporting collocation for separating headline appearance from underlying substance — used here because much of Walmart's beat came from tariff refunds rather than real sales growth.
cards.tiesTo: Walmart's beat-and-raise stock drop on earnings-quality concerns

cards.meaning: formal retraction/withdrawal — the act of officially taking back a statement or testimony
cards.example: Ibinawi ni Guteza ang kanyang testimonya laban kay Romualdez, dahil umano sa panggigipit sa kanya ng ilang mambabatas.
cards.exampleMeaning: Guteza withdrew his testimony against Romualdez, allegedly because of pressure from some lawmakers.
cards.note: From the verb 'bawiin' (to take back/retract). More formal and legal in register than the everyday 'binago niya ang sinabi niya' (he changed what he said) — 'pagbawi' specifically names the formal act of withdrawing a sworn statement or testimony, the word you'd hear in news and court reporting, not casual conversation.
cards.tiesTo: Orly Guteza formally recanting his testimony in the flood-control kickback scandal

cards.meaning: advancement, upward progress — usually at a national/economic scale
cards.example: Unang beses bumaba nang isang-digit ang antas ng kahirapan sa Pilipinas — isang malaking hakbang sa pag-asenso ng bansa.
cards.exampleMeaning: For the first time, poverty in the Philippines dropped to single digits — a big step in the country's advancement.
cards.note: From the root 'asenso' (progress/advancement) plus the 'pag-' gerund prefix, framing it as an ongoing upward process. More macro and formal than the everyday 'gumaganda ang buhay' (life is getting better), which describes one person's day-to-day situation — 'pag-asenso' is the register used for economic and national development.
cards.tiesTo: PSA's poverty incidence falling to single digits (9.7%) for the first time
